## SimulationCall.gasUsed property

Gas consumed by this call's root frame, not a safe gas limit. This is post-refund consumption and does not account for EIP-150's 63/64 rule in nested calls, so consumers deriving a limit must add their own headroom, larger than headroom derived from `eth_estimateGas`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly gasUsed: bigint;
```
